Updated October 2026 The best meal plans in Dubai, compared

By the Messify team · Updated October 2026 · 5 min read

Quick answer

The best meal plan in Dubai depends on your goal. For weight loss and macros, diet plans like Calo, Right Bite, Kcal and VMeals lead. For everyday meals, Messify costs AED 25.63–30.71 a meal and delivers all the day's meals every morning in Academic City, Silicon Oasis and International City. Prices below are as published on 13 October 2026.

We're Messify, so we're not neutral. To keep this useful, we've stuck to what each company publishes on its own website, linked every source, and listed prices exactly as shown on 13 October 2026. Prices and offers change often, so check the latest before you buy.

Plans are priced in different ways (per meal, per day or per month), so compare carefully. Our meal plan cost guide explains how to work out the price per meal.

Two kinds of meal plan

Diet and nutrition plans are built around a goal: weight loss, muscle gain, calorie targets or a specific diet such as keto. Most of the well-known names in Dubai, including Calo, Right Bite, Kcal and VMeals, are in this group.

Everyday meal plans replace ordering in or cooking. They focus on normal, balanced, home-style food at a predictable price, without calorie tracking. Messify is an everyday meal plan.

Which meal plan is best for you?

  • You want to lose weight or hit macros: a diet plan such as Calo, Right Bite, Kcal or VMeals, which are built for calorie and macro targets.
  • You want the lowest published price per meal: Right Bite lists its Essentials plan from AED 22 a meal; Messify's 3-meal monthly plan is AED 25.63 a meal. Check what each price includes and how many days you get to use your meals.
  • You live or study in Academic City, Silicon Oasis or International City and just want your everyday meals sorted: Messify, from AED 25 a meal, with the whole day's meals delivered every morning.
  • You need vegetarian food: Messify has a vegetarian option every day, for every meal; Calo, VMeals and Meals On Me also list vegetarian plans.
  • Your schedule changes week to week: look for plans that let you skip days. With Messify, every meal is a token you can use later in your plan.

How to choose: a 5-point checklist

  1. Delivery to your exact building. Coverage varies a lot between companies.
  2. Price per meal, not the headline plan price.
  3. Days to use your meals, and whether you can skip or pause.
  4. Menu variety, so you keep eating it after week two.
  5. Dietary needs: halal, vegetarian, allergies or a specific diet.

Questions people ask

What is the best meal plan in Dubai?

It depends on your goal. For weight loss or calorie targets, diet plans such as Calo, Right Bite, Kcal and VMeals are built for that. For everyday meals at a predictable price in Academic City, Silicon Oasis or International City, Messify starts from AED 25 a meal.

What is the cheapest meal plan in Dubai?

Of the published prices we checked on 13 October 2026, Right Bite listed its Essentials plan from AED 22 a meal, and Messify's 3-meal monthly plan is AED 25.63 a meal. Compare what each price includes, delivery coverage and how long you have to use your meals.

Are Dubai meal plans halal?

Every Messify meal is 100% halal. Check each company's website for its own policy.

Which Dubai meal plans have vegetarian options?

Messify has a vegetarian option every day, for every meal. Calo, VMeals and Meals On Me also list vegetarian plans.

Can I skip days on a meal plan?

With Messify, yes: skip a day in the app and use that meal later in your plan. Monthly plans give you 30 days to use 26 days of meals, and weekly plans give you 9 days to use 7.
